notes.title: Performance update released
notes.notes:
We just released update with a lot of optimizations that should address most of the performance issues.

Fixes:
- many performance fixes
- quality settings as option ingame
- dynamic resolution switching option
- checkpoint during mech levels
- and much more

Here's little comparison video showing first level before and after optimizations with SteamVR frame times chart.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iIAn6yitf6k

notes.title: Performance update, DLCs and more
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We want to announce that in the few next days we will release update fix that will address performance issues as well as some other fixes.

We also want to inform you guys that we are working on DLC packs with additional levels with even harder puzzles. Below is sample video of one of new levels.

And finally we are working on something we like to call "Director's Cut" update that will add alternative ending, additional fixes and updates among which we would like to include better hand presence.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pmbSk8Jepqw
